prefabs.title: Traffic pyramid / 5 vertices
prefabs.anchor: Bottom tip / base centre; +Y is up
prefabs.behaviour: Retained pickable comparison solid; the pyramid marks a boundary, the bipyramid is an optional crystal study.
prefabs.learn: Four base corners and one apex. A square pyramid can borrow the warning role of a traffic cone.

prefabs.title: Pentagonal bipyramid / 7 vertices
prefabs.anchor: Bottom tip / base centre; +Y is up
prefabs.behaviour: Retained pickable comparison solid; the pyramid marks a boundary, the bipyramid is an optional crystal study.
prefabs.learn: Five corners around a waist plus two tips; ten triangular faces. Seven vertices does not determine a unique solid.

prefabs.title: Melencolia / construction court
prefabs.anchor: Centre of original court volume; nominal bottom is local Y = −0.5
prefabs.behaviour: Walkable 5 × 5 m court; 25 original one-metre concrete blocks, 25 timber sheets, fitted rim and warm work lights. The existing two wedges provide access.
prefabs.learn: Recompose the known kit into a usable place. The court does not introduce a new primitive.

prefabs.title: White balls / surface test
prefabs.anchor: Centre of each emitted sphere; a shared plane above the sampled surface
prefabs.behaviour: White equal balls released from above, without a launch impulse. Default diameter 20 cm; individual encounters can configure radius. This is an emitter attached to a surface, not a freestanding pickup.
prefabs.learn: A neutral repeated body tests pockets, slope and continuity; distinguish the body from its trail and from a colour mapping.

prefabs.title: Wood crank / metal rod / piston
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local origin; ceiling brackets at 5.64 m. Keep physical assemblies at unit scale.
prefabs.behaviour: Pull the existing rose force grips. The joints stay attached. RESET begins a matched trial; a result is observed from physical bodies.
prefabs.learn: Rotation constrains a metal connecting rod; the rod translates a wooden piston. Contact can deliver a ball. Unpin the rod: turning alone no longer guarantees delivery.

prefabs.title: Working lever / two effort arms
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local origin; ceiling brackets at 5.64 m. Keep physical assemblies at unit scale.
prefabs.behaviour: Pull the existing rose force grips. The joints stay attached. RESET begins a matched trial; a result is observed from physical bodies.
prefabs.learn: Pull the same loaded beam at two distances from its pivot. A real hinge and attached rigid load determine what lifts.

prefabs.title: Rope / suspended construction cube
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local origin; ceiling brackets at 5.64 m. Keep physical assemblies at unit scale.
prefabs.behaviour: Pull the existing rose force grips. The joints stay attached. RESET begins a matched trial; a result is observed from physical bodies.
prefabs.learn: Pull and release the cube with a bounded force grip. Four pinned links keep it attached; gravity, contact and the slot determine its passage.

prefabs.title: Gravity / sort by physical size
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local origin; ceiling brackets at 5.64 m. Keep physical assemblies at unit scale.
prefabs.behaviour: Pull the existing rose force grips. The joints stay attached. RESET begins a matched trial; a result is observed from physical bodies.
prefabs.learn: Release three differently sized white spheres of equal mass onto identical diverging rails. Gravity and contact decide where each exits; the readout observes those exits.

prefabs.title: Hand wheel / visible sine yoke
prefabs.anchor: Floor origin at timber feet. Mechanism and support are editable groups; wheel, pin, slot and cube stay coupled.
prefabs.behaviour: Turn the exposed crank by hand. The pin slides horizontally inside the yoke, whose height carries a timber cube on vertical guides. Stop or reverse at any position.
prefabs.learn: The circle's vertical coordinate becomes the cube's displacement. A sine in time requires constant turning speed.

prefabs.title: Hand wheel / scale zoetrope
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local disk axis. Five-metre disk top at 2 m; crank at 1.18 m, control face at 1.98 m. Controls face +Z and stand beyond the enlarged disk.
prefabs.behaviour: A five-metre black-steel disk carries 24 fixed off-white cubes with dark outlines at two metres above the floor. Pink crank grips and fader caps mark the touch surfaces. The motor yields to your hand. Starts at 60 RPM and 12 Hz.
prefabs.learn: A discrete display samples moving fixed-size objects. One cube advance per sample holds its position while size changes; detuning reveals drift.

prefabs.title: TriangleTable / folded edge assembly
prefabs.anchor: Floor beneath the existing table. Support, controls and all twelve faces are separately editable.
prefabs.behaviour: Twelve starting movable 3-sided panels. Select a fold from flat, bring two parallel free edges together and release. Lift a face to detach; other faces stay in place. Gold marks a candidate edge. Kinematic joins, not force-simulated glue. Six more faces appear when the loose stock is used; MORE FACES can request them earlier.
prefabs.learn: An edge fixes two shared endpoints while allowing a chosen fold into space.

prefabs.title: Square faces / folded edge assembly
prefabs.anchor: Floor beneath the existing table. Support, controls and all twelve faces are separately editable.
prefabs.behaviour: Twelve starting movable 4-sided panels. Select a fold from flat, bring two parallel free edges together and release. Lift a face to detach; other faces stay in place. Gold marks a candidate edge. Kinematic joins, not force-simulated glue. Six more faces appear when the loose stock is used; MORE FACES can request them earlier.
prefabs.learn: An edge fixes two shared endpoints while allowing a chosen fold into space.

prefabs.title: Hand wheel / one cube turntable
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local plate axis. Plate top 1.05 m; controls face +Z and remain at hand height.
prefabs.behaviour: Turn a compact 1.10-metre platform carrying one centered off-white cube. Hand input, speed and direction rotate the cube in place with its plate. Black steel, pink grips and the shared machine finish.
prefabs.learn: One centered cube stays fixed to a rotating platform: orientation changes while the center stays in place.

prefabs.title: Wheel / cylinder / torus
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local; place a barber sleeve centered on a 0.9 m square structural pillar.
prefabs.behaviour: An exposed finite connecting rod converts wheel rotation into a 1.60 m horizontal stroke. A white cylinder with red bands enters a stationary pink torus. Ideal kinematics, not simulated force or pumping.
prefabs.learn: An exposed finite connecting rod converts wheel rotation into a 1.60 m horizontal stroke. A white cylinder with red bands enters a stationary pink torus. Ideal kinematics, not simulated force or pumping.

prefabs.title: Pillar / pink red white barber roll
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local; place a barber sleeve centered on a 0.9 m square structural pillar.
prefabs.behaviour: A pink/red/white helical sleeve physically rotates around a stationary structural pillar. No band moves vertically: a fixed witness makes the apparent climb and real rotation visible.
prefabs.learn: A pink/red/white helical sleeve physically rotates around a stationary structural pillar. No band moves vertically: a fixed witness makes the apparent climb and real rotation visible.

prefabs.title: Two wheels / one belt / 2:1
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local fixed pulley bearings; front interaction faces +Z. Large pitch diameter 2.20m; small 1.10m.
prefabs.behaviour: Turn either of two unequal wheels linked by a visible open belt. One large-wheel turn produces two small-wheel turns in the same direction. Pink spokes and travelling belt witnesses expose the ratio. Ideal no-slip kinematics, not a force or tension simulation.
prefabs.learn: Equal belt travel means twice the turns at half the radius. Either wheel can supply the input.

prefabs.title: Logic / AND / gravity
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local. Table top .84m, rolling surface1.08m; input cubes .24m and white balls .0672m diameter.
prefabs.behaviour: A one-metre timber slope with a 30cm rise supplies the motion. Lift the pink stop: Jolt simulates the white balls, falling input cubes on slider guides, and a motor-free hinged impact target. No spring launch, prescribed ball velocity or input seating snap. Double working size on a reachable platform.
prefabs.learn: Two missing supports in series; both cubes must fall into place for the launched ball to hit the end target.

prefabs.title: Logic / OR / gravity
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local. Table top .84m, rolling surface1.08m; input cubes .24m and white balls .0672m diameter.
prefabs.behaviour: A one-metre timber slope with a 30cm rise supplies the motion. Lift the pink stop: Jolt simulates the white balls, falling input cubes on slider guides, and a motor-free hinged impact target. No spring launch, prescribed ball velocity or input seating snap. Double working size on a reachable platform.
prefabs.learn: Two parallel lanes and two simultaneously launched test balls. A target hit on either route records one.

prefabs.title: Logic / NOT / gravity
prefabs.anchor: Floor-local. Table top .84m, rolling surface1.08m; input cubes .24m and white balls .0672m diameter.
prefabs.behaviour: A one-metre timber slope with a 30cm rise supplies the motion. Lift the pink stop: Jolt simulates the white balls, falling input cubes on slider guides, and a motor-free hinged impact target. No spring launch, prescribed ball velocity or input seating snap. Double working size on a reachable platform.
prefabs.learn: One continuous run. Input one drops a blocker; actual blocker contact records zero. With the blocker raised, an end-target hit records one.

prefabs.title: Tape / give a line a surface
prefabs.anchor: Roll centre; endpoints attach in each touched object local frame
prefabs.behaviour: Three tape rolls on a temporary timber crate. Click once to set the start, then click again to place one continuous strip. Freehand drawing is optional. Marks follow their touched objects. Tape between separate physics bodies binds them with reversible native joints. Undo removes one span or stroke; Tidy refills and resets.
prefabs.learn: A line changes from a measured relation into an authored mark, claim or boundary. The same two endpoints carry different implications when the roll changes.

prefabs.title: Tape roll / masking
prefabs.anchor: Roll centre; endpoints attach in each touched object local frame
prefabs.behaviour: Five-centimetre pale masking tape. Click start, then click end for one strip. Freehand surface stripes are opt-in. Separate physics bodies bind with native joints.
prefabs.learn: The measured segment becomes a temporary mark on a material surface.

prefabs.title: Tape roll / pink marking
prefabs.anchor: Roll centre; endpoints attach in each touched object local frame
prefabs.behaviour: Seven-and-a-half-centimetre pink marking tape. Click start, then click end for one strip. Freehand surface stripes are opt-in. Separate physics bodies bind with native joints.
prefabs.learn: The visitor chooses which line deserves attention.

prefabs.title: Tape roll / striped barrier
prefabs.anchor: Roll centre; endpoints attach in each touched object local frame
prefabs.behaviour: Twelve-centimetre pink/black striped barrier tape. A visible boundary; spans can bind objects, without creating an invisible collision wall.
prefabs.learn: A boundary is placed by someone; the strip makes its author visible.

prefabs.title: Logic / event chain
prefabs.anchor: Original local mechanism frame; actual scale one.
prefabs.behaviour: Release the existing tyre; contacts carry motion through plank, wedge and boxes.
prefabs.learn: A contact can trigger another event without imposing a truth table.

prefabs.title: Logic / hand-built assemblage
prefabs.anchor: Collection origin; independently editable timber pieces.
prefabs.behaviour: Take apart, arrange, test gravity and save through the existing shared handmade-prefab system. Saving creates no joints.
prefabs.learn: A person can supply the relation before it becomes a reusable construction.

prefabs.title: Plank / move the pivot
prefabs.anchor: Floor origin; separate landings and entry ramp; bearing and plank remain a coupled editable mechanism.
prefabs.behaviour: Slide the pink bearing along the exposed rail, then turn the pink end grip. The six-metre timber walkway turns around the chosen centre. Real walkable collision, ideal constrained linkage.
prefabs.learn: Changing the centre changes the path of the same rotation.

prefabs.title: Sun feather / ten transformed prefabs
prefabs.anchor: Floor origin. Table, controls and each of the ten transformed copies remain independent editor parts.
prefabs.behaviour: Ten familiar line prefabs arranged around a circumference. Retained sliders change rotation and scale between copies; compare blue DO NOT CROSS barriers with timber planks.
prefabs.learn: Copy i repeats the same rotation and scale about the shared insertion point.

prefabs.title: DO NOT CROSS / from toy to architecture
prefabs.anchor: Floor origin at the west-side study. Individual barriers and their supports remain editable.
prefabs.behaviour: Nine original blue barriers grow along a line. Three begin on a wooden table, two on lower packing blocks, and the last four stand on the floor. Three exceed normal size; the largest is 5.5 metres wide.
prefabs.learn: Scaling a familiar body changes its relation to the hand, player and architecture.
